metadata.title: KOSPI Index Enters Bear Market as Samsung, SK Hynix Lead Memory-Chip Selloff<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
The World’s Hottest Stock Market Just Fell Into a Bear Market. What History Says Happens Next.
The world’s hottest index has been dragged into a technical bear market as the memory-chip selloff gathered pace Wednesday. But there’s reason to believe it can recover and trade higher over the next 18 months.
